# One-texture clothes selectors, one per prescripted ruler that would
# otherwise index a master selector.
#
# A prescripted ruler whose species portrait uses a humanoid_master_*
# clothes selector cannot be dressed by an index: that selector is shared
# by 44 species classes, and what `clothes = N` enumerates in it is not
# something this container can establish -- a model inferred from one
# data point was falsified by a live run at all six positions.
# STNH's own answer is a one-texture selector plus `clothes = 0`, which is
# the one index a live run HAS confirmed. See
# .docs/decisions/65-ruler-clothes-dedicated-selectors.md.
